_comment: Hand-curated CLINICAL FINDING demos for the Video tab. Rule: only attach when the clip actually SHOWS the abnormal finding (patient or clearly abnormal segment). Do NOT attach normal OSCE technique exams (Stanford/Geeky Medics style) for 'what does X look like' questions — those teach how to test, not the pathology. merge-clinical-exam.mjs deep-links startSec when known.

intention_tremor_abnormal.title: Abnormal Coordination Exam — Cerebellar Intention Tremor
intention_tremor_abnormal.why: Patient clip: cerebellar intention tremor maximal near the target (scene 1); contrasts postural and rest tremor

dysmetria_finger_nose_abnormal.title: Abnormal Coordination Exam — Finger-to-nose (Dysmetria)
dysmetria_finger_nose_abnormal.why: Abnormal finger–nose: dysmetria (over/undershoot) and movement decomposition with appendicular ataxia

dysdiadochokinesia_abnormal.title: Abnormal Coordination Exam — Hand Rapid Alternating Movements
dysdiadochokinesia_abnormal.why: Abnormal rapid alternating movements = dysdiadochokinesia (irregular, poorly timed hand flips)

dysdiadochokinesia_normal_abnormal.title: Dysdiadochokinesia — Normal and Abnormal
dysdiadochokinesia_normal_abnormal.why: Side-by-side normal vs abnormal rapid alternating movements (dysdiadochokinesia)

resting_tremor_patient.title: Parkinson's Disease Real Patient’s Tremor Exam
resting_tremor_patient.why: Real patient: pill-rolling rest tremor (not a normal technique demo)

essential_tremor_patient.title: Essential Tremor vs Parkinson Tremor
essential_tremor_patient.why: Real patient with essential (action/postural) tremor on exam

parkinson_tremor_patient_jama.title: Essential Tremor vs Parkinson Tremor
parkinson_tremor_patient_jama.why: Real patient Parkinson rest tremor segment for comparison with ET

et_vs_pd_differential.title: Parkinson's Disease Real Patient’s Tremor Exam
et_vs_pd_differential.why: Same real-patient exam: Parkinson vs essential tremor features

catatonia_historic.title: Catatonia — Negativism, Waxy Flexibility, Catalepsy (1940s)
catatonia_historic.why: Historic patient footage: immobility, resistance to repositioning, maintained postures (catalepsy)

catatonia_hypokinetic_bfcrs.title: Bush-Francis — Hypokinetic Catatonia
catatonia_hypokinetic_bfcrs.why: Standardized-patient BFCRS exam of hypokinetic catatonia (stupor, posturing, catalepsy-type signs)

waxy_flexibility.title: Waxy Flexibility | Bush-Francis Catatonia Rating Scale
waxy_flexibility.why: Focused BFCRS demo of waxy flexibility on exam

aims_exam.title: Abnormal Involuntary Movement Scale (AIMS Scale)
aims_exam.why: Walks through AIMS with movement examples used to rate tardive dyskinesia

acute_dystonia_patient.title: Acute Dystonic Reaction
acute_dystonia_patient.why: Real ED patient with acute dystonia after risperidone; treatment with diphenhydramine shown

oculogyric_crisis.title: Oculogyric Crisis
oculogyric_crisis.why: Clinical example of oculogyric crisis (acute dystonic eye deviation)

asterixis_patient.title: Asterixis of Upper and Lower Extremities
asterixis_patient.why: Patient demonstration of asterixis (flapping tremor) in hands and feet

asterixis_demo.title: Flapping Tremor — Asterixis
asterixis_demo.why: Demonstration of flapping tremor / asterixis (hepatic encephalopathy context)
